challenge.name: Tracking Reproducibility Lost
challenge.description: #model_monica# insists on automated experiment tracking to ensure reproducibility. #data_dave# thinks that is overkill and wants to keep it manual to save costs. The team is stuck.

output.content: {data_dave} emphasized the need to reduce costs in the experiment tracking process. He pointed out that maintaining manual tracking is sufficient for our current needs and that automating this process would introduce unnecessary expenses. He suggested exploring ways to optimize the existing manual system to achieve cost savings. The more we can reduce costs, the better it aligns with data operations goals.
output.reclassify_reason: Doing more than asked (automating) would not make them happier, but reducing costs further aligns with their goals.
